question: ICC CWC League 2: Nepal vs Netherlands who will win on 29th July?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Nepal ": Wins if Nepal is the officially confirmed winner of the ICC CWC League 2 match between Netherlands and Nepal played on 29 July 2026 at Utrecht (119th Match of the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup League 2 2023–2027), as reported by ESPNcricinfo or the ICC.
- "Netherlands ": Wins if Netherlands is the officially confirmed winner of the ICC CWC League 2 match between Netherlands and Nepal played on 29 July 2026 at Utrecht (119th Match of the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup League 2 2023–2027), as reported by ESPNcricinfo or the ICC.

Clarifications:
- If the match is abandoned or ends with no result (e.g. washed out with no reserve day), neither outcome wins and the market is considered unresolvable.
- If the match result is determined via a Duckworth-Lewis-Stern (DLS) method reduction, the officially confirmed winner under DLS is used.
